newsitem.title: USA: Reader's Digest Q3 U.S. revs down.
newsitem.headline: Reader's Digest Q3 U.S. revs down.

text.p: The Reader's Digest Association Inc said Wednesday that revenues from U.S. operations for the third fiscal quarter ended March 31 were $308.8 million, a decrease of two percent compared with last year.
Excluding prior-year revenues from Travel Holiday magazine, which was sold in the third quarter of fiscal 1996, revenues were about the same as a year ago, the company said.

Revenues from books and home entertainment products declined slightly from last year because increases in general books being more than offset by declines in Condensed Books and video, the company said.
The decline in Condensed Books is from lower membership and reduced responses to January mailings, the company said.
Operating profit increased primarily due to the benefit of cost-containment initiatives, the company said.
Revenues from European operations decreased 16 percent to $276.6 million, the company said.
Excluding the effect of foreign currency changes, the decrease was about 12 percent.
